video-editor-openai 1.0.0

- Initial release of AI-powered video editing skill.
- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and give editing instructions via text.
- Automated cloud render pipeline delivers fast 1080p MP4 exports ready to download.
- Supports editing commands like cutting pauses, adding background music, text overlays, aspect ratio changes, and more.
- No video editing software experience required; just describe the edits you want.
- Built-in session handling, error recovery, free limited-use token support, and real-time status updates.
